pages.text: $(bold)Yo-Yo$()$(br2)Obtaining: craft it at the $(bold)Tinker Station$() — combining two Yo-Yo Wheels + a Reel + a Bowstring.$(br2)Features:$(li)$(bold)right-click$() to launch a spinning yo-yo forward$(li)after touching a creature or reaching its maximum flight distance, it $(bold)lingers for 3 seconds$()$(li)while lingering, it deals $(bold)10% of its total damage$() per frame to the entities it touches$(li)it then flies back on its own

$(bold)Tips$(): during the yo-yo's 3-second linger you can repeatedly pass it through the target to rack up many hits, making it a powerful sustained-damage weapon; paired with material combat traits (such as Dragon Flame and Gale), the trait can trigger on every contact frame.
